0022600175.text: The Celtics (5-2, 3rd in the East and 1.5 games behind for 2nd in the Atlantic) host the Bucks (1-6, 14th in the East), with Boston coming off a loss and Milwaukee on a three-game losing streak. Jayson Tatum (rest) and Devin Carter (illness) are out for Boston, and Kam Jones (ankle) is out for Milwaukee. The teams have not met yet this season, but the Celtics won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 133-101 win in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026.
